# GBM ECM Analysis

## RNAseq ECM Analysis

To look at the gene expression of ECM genes across primary and recurrent GBM in CGGA data sets. 

### Library

```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(httr)
library(pheatmap)
library(biomaRt)
library(limma)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(tidyverse)
library(tibble)
library(readr)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(enrichplot)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
```
### Download and upload input data

Data downloaded from https://www.cgga.org.cn/download.jsp

Data that are already downloaded are not downloaded again. Chunks are skipped using , eval = FALSE in chunk. 

#### Download mRNAseq_693 data

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# Download expression data from STAR+RSEM (FPKM Value) 
GET(
  "https://www.cgga.org.cn/download?file=download/20200506/CGGA.mRNAseq_693.RSEM-genes.20200506.txt.zip&type=mRNAseq_693&time=20200506",
  write_disk(file.path("/Data/Inputs", "CGGA.mRNAseq_693.RSEM-genes.20200506.txt.zip"), overwrite = TRUE),
  timeout(600)
)

# Unzip file and remove __MACOSX folder
unzip(file.path("/Data/Inputs", "CGGA.mRNAseq_693.RSEM-genes.20200506.txt.zip"), exdir = "/Data/Inputs")
unlink(file.path("/Data/Inputs", "__MACOSX"), recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)

# Download clinical meta data
GET(
  "https://www.cgga.org.cn/download?file=download/20200506/CGGA.mRNAseq_693_clinical.20200506.txt.zip&type=mRNAseq_693_clinical&time=20200506",
  write_disk(file.path("/Data/Inputs", "CGGA.mRNAseq_693_clinical.20200506.txt.zip"), overwrite = TRUE),
  timeout(600)
)

# Unzip file and remove __MACOSX folder
unzip(file.path("/Data/Inputs", "CGGA.mRNAseq_693_clinical.20200506.txt.zip"), exdir = "/Data/Inputs")
unlink(file.path("/Data/Inputs", "__MACOSX"), recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)

```

### Filtering data to only include samples that follow WHO 2021 classification. 


Removed Samples that are not classified as GBM.

```{r}
# Load CGGA-693 metadata
cgga693_meta <- read.delim("/Data/Inputs/CGGA.mRNAseq_693_clinical.20200506.txt",
                           header = TRUE,
                           check.names = FALSE,
                           stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Load CGGA-325 metadata
cgga325_meta <- read.delim("/Data/Inputs/CGGA.mRNAseq_325_clinical.20200506.txt",
                           header = TRUE,
                           check.names = FALSE,
                           stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

```{r}

# Filter CGGA-693: keep GBM/rGBM, remove IDH mutant, remove 1p19q codel
cgga693_meta_gbm <- cgga693_meta %>%
  filter(tolower(Histology) %in% c("gbm", "rgbm")) %>%
  filter(tolower(IDH_mutation_status) != "mutant") %>%
  filter(tolower(`1p19q_codeletion_status`) != "codel")

# Filter CGGA-325: keep GBM/rGBM, remove IDH mutant, remove 1p19q codel
cgga325_meta_gbm <- cgga325_meta %>%
  filter(tolower(Histology) %in% c("gbm", "rgbm")) %>%
  filter(tolower(IDH_mutation_status) != "mutant") %>%
  filter(tolower(`1p19q_codeletion_status`) != "codel")
```

The meta data shows many columns describing the phenotype of each sample. Within the meta data, irradiation status is listed as 0 or 1. Gene expression profile of ECM genes should be analyzed between recurrent tumors that received irradiation and tumors that did not. This may give insight into irradiation induced ECM change. 

### Add filters to gene expression data

```{r}
# Load CGGA-693 gene expression data
cgga693_expr <- read.delim("/Data/Inputs/CGGA.mRNAseq_693.RSEM-genes.20200506.txt",
                           header = TRUE,
                           check.names = FALSE,
                           stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Load CGGA-325 gene expression data
cgga325_expr <- read.delim("/Data/Inputs/CGGA.mRNAseq_325.RSEM-genes.20200506.txt",
                           header = TRUE,
                           check.names = FALSE,
                           stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

#### Filter expression data using filtered meta data

There is a problem using select() function, so the code below specifies to use dplyr 

```{r}
# cgga 693 filter
ids_693 <- intersect(colnames(cgga693_expr)[-1], cgga693_meta_gbm$CGGA_ID)

cgga693_expr_filt <- cgga693_expr %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene_Name, dplyr::all_of(ids_693))

cgga693_meta_gbm_ord <- cgga693_meta_gbm %>%
  dplyr::filter(CGGA_ID %in% ids_693) %>%
  dplyr::slice(match(ids_693, CGGA_ID))

# cgga 325 filter
ids_325 <- intersect(colnames(cgga325_expr)[-1], cgga325_meta_gbm$CGGA_ID)

cgga325_expr_filt <- cgga325_expr %>%
  dplyr::select(Gene_Name, dplyr::all_of(ids_325))

cgga325_meta_gbm_ord <- cgga325_meta_gbm %>%
  dplyr::filter(CGGA_ID %in% ids_325) %>%
  dplyr::slice(match(ids_325, CGGA_ID))
```

### Load non-glioma control to environment

```{r}
# Load the control expression data
control_expr <- read.delim("/Data/Inputs/CGGA_RNAseq_Control_20.txt",
                           header = TRUE,
                           check.names = FALSE,
                           stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```


### Load GO ECM Gene set

```{r}
# ECM genes from GO:0031012 

ensembl <- useMart("ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")

ecm_genes_raw <- getBM(
  attributes = c("hgnc_symbol", "ensembl_gene_id", "go_id", "name_1006"),
  filters    = "go",
  values     = "GO:0031012",  
  mart       = ensembl
)

# Clean to unique, non-empty human symbols
ecm_genes_tbl <- ecm_genes_raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(hgnc_symbol), nzchar(hgnc_symbol)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(hgnc_symbol, .keep_all = FALSE)

# Final for filtering expression
ecm_gene_list <- unique(ecm_genes_tbl$hgnc_symbol)
```

### Merge all Genes and Data
```{r}
# ---- Harmonize control column name (as you already do later) ----
control_expr <- control_expr %>%
  dplyr::rename(Gene_Name = gene_name)

# ---- Deduplicate genes within each cohort BEFORE merging ----
cgga693_all <- cgga693_expr_filt %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Gene_Name = toupper(Gene_Name)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Gene_Name, .keep_all = TRUE)

cgga325_all <- cgga325_expr_filt %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Gene_Name = toupper(Gene_Name)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Gene_Name, .keep_all = TRUE)

control_all <- control_expr %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Gene_Name = toupper(Gene_Name)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(Gene_Name, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ---- Intersect to common genes across all three (still ALL genes) ----
common_genes_all <- Reduce(intersect, list(
  cgga693_all$Gene_Name,
  cgga325_all$Gene_Name,
  control_all$Gene_Name
))

cgga693_all_common <- cgga693_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(Gene_Name %in% common_genes_all) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Gene_Name)

cgga325_all_common <- cgga325_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(Gene_Name %in% common_genes_all) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Gene_Name)

control_all_common <- control_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(Gene_Name %in% common_genes_all) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Gene_Name)

# ---- Ensure unique sample IDs across cohorts (add suffixes only if needed) ----
samp_693 <- setdiff(colnames(cgga693_all_common), "Gene_Name")
samp_325 <- setdiff(colnames(cgga325_all_common), "Gene_Name")
samp_ctl <- setdiff(colnames(control_all_common), "Gene_Name")

overlap_693_325 <- intersect(samp_693, samp_325)
overlap_693_ctl  <- intersect(samp_693, samp_ctl)
overlap_325_ctl  <- intersect(samp_325, samp_ctl)

if (length(overlap_693_325) > 0 || length(overlap_693_ctl) > 0) {
  colnames(cgga693_all_common)[match(samp_693, colnames(cgga693_all_common))] <- paste0(samp_693, "_693")
}
if (length(overlap_693_325) > 0 || length(overlap_325_ctl) > 0) {
  colnames(cgga325_all_common)[match(samp_325, colnames(cgga325_all_common))] <- paste0(samp_325, "_325")
}
if (length(overlap_693_ctl) > 0 || length(overlap_325_ctl) > 0) {
  colnames(control_all_common)[match(samp_ctl, colnames(control_all_common))] <- paste0(samp_ctl, "_CTRL")
}

# ---- Merge ALL genes by Gene_Name ----
merged_expr_all <- Reduce(
  function(x, y) dplyr::inner_join(x, y, by = "Gene_Name"),
  list(cgga693_all_common, cgga325_all_common, control_all_common)
)

stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(merged_expr_all$Gene_Name))
stopifnot(sum(duplicated(colnames(merged_expr_all))) == 0)

```

##### Merge meta data

```{r}
# --- MERGE META DATA (with survival) ---


# 'merged_expr_all' already built above
merged_samples <- colnames(merged_expr_all)[-1]

# Base meta frames (Group/Cohort)
meta693 <- cgga693_meta %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    sample_id = CGGA_ID,
    group  = dplyr::if_else(tolower(Histology) == "rgbm", "rGBM", "GBM"),
    cohort = "CGGA693"
  )

meta325 <- cgga325_meta %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    sample_id = CGGA_ID,
    group  = dplyr::if_else(tolower(Histology) == "rgbm", "rGBM", "GBM"),
    cohort = "CGGA325"
  )

ctl_ids <- setdiff(colnames(control_all_common), "Gene_Name")
metaCTL <- tibble::tibble(
  sample_id = ctl_ids,
  group  = "Control",
  cohort = "Control"
)

# Helper: append suffix ONLY if present in merged sample IDs
add_suffix_if_needed <- function(df, suffix) {
  needs_suffix <- any(grepl(paste0(suffix, "$"), merged_samples))
  if (needs_suffix) df$sample_id <- paste0(df$sample_id, suffix)
  df
}

meta693 <- add_suffix_if_needed(meta693, "_693")
meta325 <- add_suffix_if_needed(meta325, "_325")
metaCTL <- add_suffix_if_needed(metaCTL, "_CTRL")

# Combine base meta and keep only samples that exist in merged expression
sample_meta_all <- dplyr::bind_rows(meta693, meta325, metaCTL) %>%
  dplyr::filter(sample_id %in% merged_samples) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(sample_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Add radio/chemo
meta693_extra <- cgga693_meta %>%
  dplyr::select(
    CGGA_ID,
    `Radio_status (treated=1;un-treated=0)`,
    `Chemo_status (TMZ treated=1;un-treated=0)`
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    sample_id   = CGGA_ID,
    Radio_status = `Radio_status (treated=1;un-treated=0)`,
    Chemo_status = `Chemo_status (TMZ treated=1;un-treated=0)`
  ) %>% add_suffix_if_needed("_693")

meta325_extra <- cgga325_meta %>%
  dplyr::select(
    CGGA_ID,
    `Radio_status (treated=1;un-treated=0)`,
    `Chemo_status (TMZ treated=1;un-treated=0)`
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    sample_id   = CGGA_ID,
    Radio_status = `Radio_status (treated=1;un-treated=0)`,
    Chemo_status = `Chemo_status (TMZ treated=1;un-treated=0)`
  ) %>% add_suffix_if_needed("_325")

metaCTL_extra <- tibble::tibble(
  sample_id = ctl_ids,
  Radio_status = NA_integer_,
  Chemo_status = NA_integer_
) %>% add_suffix_if_needed("_CTRL")

# ---- NEW: bring in survival (OS_days, OS_event) ----
surv693 <- cgga693_meta %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    sample_id = CGGA_ID,
    OS_days   = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(OS)),
    OS_event  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`Censor (alive=0; dead=1)`))
  ) %>% add_suffix_if_needed("_693")

surv325 <- cgga325_meta %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    sample_id = CGGA_ID,
    OS_days   = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(OS)),
    OS_event  = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`Censor (alive=0; dead=1)`))
  ) %>% add_suffix_if_needed("_325")

survCTL <- tibble::tibble(
  sample_id = ctl_ids,
  OS_days   = NA_real_,
  OS_event  = NA_real_
) %>% add_suffix_if_needed("_CTRL")

# Merge everything into sample_meta_all
sample_meta_all <- sample_meta_all %>%
  dplyr::left_join(dplyr::bind_rows(meta693_extra, meta325_extra, metaCTL_extra), by = "sample_id") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(dplyr::bind_rows(surv693, surv325, survCTL), by = "sample_id")

# Sanity checks
stopifnot(setequal(sample_meta_all$sample_id, merged_samples))
message("Survival rows with data: ", sum(!is.na(sample_meta_all$OS_days)), 
        " | events present: ", sum(!is.na(sample_meta_all$OS_event)))

# (Optional) a convenience in years for plotting tables
sample_meta_all <- sample_meta_all %>%
  dplyr::mutate(OS_years = ifelse(!is.na(OS_days), OS_days / 365.25, NA_real_))

```

### Normalization and QC

```{r}
# Wide genes x samples matrix
expr_mat_all <- merged_expr_all %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Gene_Name") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Align meta row order to columns exactly
sample_meta_all <- sample_meta_all %>%
  dplyr::slice(match(colnames(expr_mat_all), sample_id))
stopifnot(identical(sample_meta_all$sample_id, colnames(expr_mat_all)))

# Log2 transform for QC/visualization
expr_log2_all <- log2(expr_mat_all + 1)

# Long table for QC plots
expr_all_long <- expr_log2_all %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Gene_Name") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-Gene_Name, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "log2_expr") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(sample_meta_all, by = "sample_id") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    group  = factor(group,  levels = c("Control", "GBM", "rGBM")),
    cohort = factor(cohort, levels = c("Control", "CGGA693", "CGGA325"))
  )

# QC: per-sample distributions
ggplot(expr_all_long, aes(x = sample_id, y = log2_expr, fill = group)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.5, width = 0.6) +
  facet_grid(~ cohort, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  labs(title = "ALL genes: per-sample log2(FPKM+1) distributions",
       x = "Sample", y = "log2 expression") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top")

```
#### Batch effect correction

```{r}
# Indices
idx_tumor   <- which(sample_meta_all$group != "Control")
idx_control <- which(sample_meta_all$group == "Control")

expr_tumor_all   <- expr_log2_all[, idx_tumor, drop = FALSE]
expr_control_all <- expr_log2_all[, idx_control, drop = FALSE]

tumor_meta <- sample_meta_all[idx_tumor, , drop = FALSE] %>%
  dplyr::mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("GBM","rGBM")))

batch_tumor  <- factor(tumor_meta$cohort)
design_tumor <- model.matrix(~ group, data = tumor_meta)

expr_tumor_adj_all <- limma::removeBatchEffect(expr_tumor_all,
                                               batch = batch_tumor,
                                               design = design_tumor)

# Recombine (keep original sample order)
expr_adj_all <- expr_log2_all
expr_adj_all[, idx_tumor]   <- expr_tumor_adj_all
expr_adj_all[, idx_control] <- expr_control_all

# Quick PCA check before/after
keep_genes <- apply(expr_log2_all, 1, var) > 0
X_before <- t(expr_log2_all[keep_genes, , drop = FALSE])
X_after  <- t(expr_adj_all[keep_genes,  , drop = FALSE])

pca_before <- prcomp(X_before, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
pca_after  <- prcomp(X_after,  center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

ve_b <- (pca_before$sdev^2) / sum(pca_before$sdev^2)
ve_a <- (pca_after$sdev^2)  / sum(pca_after$sdev^2)

df_b <- as.data.frame(pca_before$x[, 1:2]) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(sample_meta_all, by = "sample_id") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(state = "Before (log2 FPKM)")

df_a <- as.data.frame(pca_after$x[, 1:2]) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(sample_meta_all, by = "sample_id") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(state = "After (tumor-only adj)")

group_cols <- c(Control = "grey40", GBM = "#1f77b4", rGBM = "#d62728")

ggplot(df_b, aes(PC1, PC2, color = group, shape = cohort)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_cols) +
  labs(title = "PCA BEFORE batch correction",
       x = paste0("PC1 (", round(100*ve_b[1], 1), "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", round(100*ve_b[2], 1), "%)")) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "top")

ggplot(df_a, aes(PC1, PC2, color = group, shape = cohort)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_cols) +
  labs(title = "PCA AFTER tumor-only batch correction",
       x = paste0("PC1 (", round(100*ve_a[1], 1), "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", round(100*ve_a[2], 1), "%)")) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "top")

```

### DEG Analysis pre-Gene list

#### Volcano

```{r}
# ---- Volcano (ALL genes) — rGBM vs Control ----
# Needs: expr_adj_all (genes x samples, batch-adjusted log2(FPKM+1))
#        sample_meta_all (columns: sample_id, group with "Control" and "rGBM")

stopifnot(exists("expr_adj_all"), exists("sample_meta_all"))
stopifnot(all(colnames(expr_adj_all) == sample_meta_all$sample_id))

# 1) Subset to rGBM + Control and design (Control baseline)
idx_keep <- which(sample_meta_all$group %in% c("Control","rGBM"))
stopifnot(length(idx_keep) > 1)

expr_rc <- expr_adj_all[, idx_keep, drop = FALSE]
meta_rc <- sample_meta_all[idx_keep, , drop = FALSE]
meta_rc$group <- factor(meta_rc$group, levels = c("Control","rGBM"))

design  <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group, data = meta_rc)
colnames(design) <- levels(meta_rc$group)
contrast <- limma::makeContrasts(rGBM_vs_Control = rGBM - Control, levels = design)

# 2) Limma on ALL genes
fit  <- limma::lmFit(expr_rc, design)
fit2 <- limma::eBayes(limma::contrasts.fit(fit, contrast))
res  <- limma::topTable(fit2, coef = "rGBM_vs_Control", number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")

res_tbl <- res %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, logFC, AveExpr, t, P.Value, adj.P.Val, B)

# 3) Prep volcano data (ALL genes; no filtering)
volc_df <- res_tbl %>%
  transmute(
    gene,
    lfc      = logFC,
    padj     = adj.P.Val,
    neglog10 = -log10(adj.P.Val)
  )

# 4) Thresholds and status
padj_cut <- 0.05
lfc_cut  <- 1.0

volc_df <- volc_df %>%
  mutate(status = case_when(
    padj < padj_cut & lfc >  lfc_cut ~ "Up",
    padj < padj_cut & lfc < -lfc_cut ~ "Down",
    TRUE                             ~ "NS"
  ))

# Labels: top 20 by |lfc| (feel free to change n)
labs <- volc_df %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(lfc))) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20) %>%
  pull(gene)

# 5) Plot
p_volc_all <- ggplot(volc_df, aes(x = lfc, y = neglog10)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = status), size = 1.6, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Up = "#d62728", Down = "#1f77b4", NS = "grey70")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(padj_cut), linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_cut, lfc_cut), linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.3) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = subset(volc_df, gene %in% labs),
    aes(label = gene),
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.35,
    point.padding = 0.2,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    seed = 123
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "All genes: rGBM vs Control (batch-adjusted, limma on ALL genes)",
    subtitle = "Contrast = rGBM − Control",
    x = expression(log[2]~fold~change),
    y = expression(-log[10]~adjusted~p~value)
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
         panel.border = element_blank()
  )

print(p_volc_all)

# 6) Save outputs
outdir <- "/Data/Outputs/All_DEG"
if (!dir.exists(outdir)) dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE)

ggsave(file.path(outdir, "Volcano_AllGenes_rGBM_vs_Control_batchAdj.pdf"),
       p_volc_all, width = 6.8, height = 5.6, units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)

# Save the plot data and full DE table
write_csv(volc_df, file.path(outdir, "Volcano_AllGenes_rGBM_vs_Control_plotdata.csv"))
write_csv(res_tbl, file.path(outdir, "DE_full_rGBM_vs_Control_allgenes_batchAdj.csv"))
```

```{r}
# 1) Load your saved DE results
res_tbl <- read_csv("/Data/Outputs/All_DEG/DE_full_rGBM_vs_Control_allgenes_batchAdj.csv",
                    show_col_types = FALSE)

# 2) Map SYMBOL → ENTREZ (required for gseGO)
sym2ent <- bitr(res_tbl$gene, fromType = "SYMBOL",
                toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)

# 3) Join with DE results, keep unique ENTREZ
rank_df <- res_tbl %>%
  inner_join(sym2ent, by = c("gene" = "SYMBOL")) %>%
  distinct(ENTREZID, .keep_all = TRUE)

# 4) Build ranked vector (t-statistic works well)
ranks <- rank_df$t
names(ranks) <- rank_df$ENTREZID
ranks <- sort(ranks, decreasing = TRUE)

# Now ranks exists and you can continue
head(ranks)
```

```{r}
# ranks: named numeric vector (ENTREZ -> t-stat)
stopifnot(exists("ranks"))
ranks <- sort(ranks, decreasing = TRUE)

set.seed(1234)

# 1) GSEA without internal filtering
ego_full <- gseGO(
  geneList      = ranks,
  OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
  keyType       = "ENTREZID",
  ont           = "BP",
  pAdjustMethod = "none",  # return raw p-values
  pvalueCutoff  = 1,       # keep everything
  minGSSize     = 10,
  maxGSSize     = 5000,
  verbose       = FALSE
)

# 2) Recompute BH FDR + prep table
df <- as.data.frame(ego_full) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    padj     = p.adjust(pvalue, method = "BH"),
    padj_eps = pmax(padj, .Machine$double.xmin)  # avoid zeros for plotting
  )


# Keep only positive NES, sort by NES desc, take top 5
topN  <- 6
df_top <- df %>%
  dplyr::filter(NES > 0) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(NES)) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = topN)

if (nrow(df_top) == 0) stop("No positively enriched pathways (NES > 0).")

# Bar plot version
p_nes <- ggplot(df_top, aes(x = NES, y = reorder(Description, NES))) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue3", width = 0.7) +
  labs(x = "Normalized Enrichment Score (NES)", y = NULL,
       title = "GO BP GSEA — rGBM vs Control (Top 6 positive NES)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.border = element_blank())

print(p_nes)
```

### DEG analysis post-Gene List ECM 

#### Heatmap

```{r}
# --- STEP 1: Prep ECM heatmap inputs (matrix + annotations) ---

stopifnot(exists("expr_adj_ecm"), exists("sample_meta_all"))
stopifnot(all(colnames(expr_adj_ecm) == sample_meta_all$sample_id))

# 1) Keep genes with some variance
gene_var <- apply(expr_adj_ecm, 1, var, na.rm = TRUE)
keep     <- gene_var > 0
mat_ecm  <- expr_adj_ecm[keep, , drop = FALSE]

# 2) (Optional) Limit to top variable ECM genes for readability
top_var_n <- 150   # <- change if you want more/less genes
ord <- order(gene_var[keep], decreasing = TRUE)
if (length(ord) > top_var_n) ord <- ord[seq_len(top_var_n)]
mat_ecm <- mat_ecm[ord, , drop = FALSE]

# 3) Row-scale (Z-score) to emphasize relative patterns across samples
row_zscore <- function(x) {
  mu <- rowMeans(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  sd <- apply(x, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  sweep(sweep(x, 1, mu, "-"), 1, pmax(sd, .Machine$double.eps), "/")
}
H_ecm <- row_zscore(mat_ecm)

# 4) Column annotations (Group, Cohort, Radio/Chemo labels)
ann_col <- sample_meta_all |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    sample_id,
    Group   = factor(group,  levels = c("Control","GBM","rGBM")),
    Cohort  = factor(cohort, levels = c("Control","CGGA693","CGGA325")),
    Radio   = dplyr::case_when(Radio_status == 1 ~ "Treated",
                               Radio_status == 0 ~ "Untreated",
                               TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    Chemo   = dplyr::case_when(Chemo_status == 1 ~ "TMZ Treated",
                               Chemo_status == 0 ~ "Untreated",
                               TRUE ~ NA_character_)
  ) |>
  tibble::column_to_rownames("sample_id")

# ensure order matches columns of H_ecm
ann_col <- ann_col[colnames(H_ecm), , drop = FALSE]

# 5) Quick sanity prints
cat("ECM heatmap matrix dims (genes x samples):", nrow(H_ecm), "x", ncol(H_ecm), "\n")
table(ann_col$Group)
table(ann_col$Cohort)

# Objects created for next step:
# - H_ecm: row-scaled matrix (genes x samples)
# - ann_col: data.frame for column annotations (rows = samples)

```

#### Volcano

```{r}
# --- Volcano: ECM genes, rGBM vs Control ---

stopifnot(exists("expr_adj_ecm"), exists("sample_meta_all"))
stopifnot(all(colnames(expr_adj_ecm) == sample_meta_all$sample_id))

# 1) Subset to rGBM + Control
keep <- sample_meta_all$group %in% c("Control","rGBM")
X    <- expr_adj_ecm[, keep, drop = FALSE]
mta  <- droplevels(sample_meta_all[keep, ])
mta$group <- factor(mta$group, levels = c("Control","rGBM"))

# 2) limma (Control baseline)
design   <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group, data = mta)
colnames(design) <- levels(mta$group)
contrast <- limma::makeContrasts(rGBM_vs_Control = rGBM - Control, levels = design)

fit  <- limma::lmFit(X, design)
fit2 <- limma::eBayes(limma::contrasts.fit(fit, contrast))
res  <- limma::topTable(fit2, coef = "rGBM_vs_Control", number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH") |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") |>
  dplyr::select(gene, logFC, AveExpr, t, P.Value, adj.P.Val, B)

# 3) Prep data
padj_cut <- 0.05
lfc_cut  <- 0.5      # ECM effects can be modest; tweak if desired

volc_df <- res |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    gene,
    lfc      = logFC,
    padj     = adj.P.Val,
    neglog10 = -log10(adj.P.Val),
    status   = dplyr::case_when(
      adj.P.Val < padj_cut & logFC >  lfc_cut ~ "Up",
      adj.P.Val < padj_cut & logFC < -lfc_cut ~ "Down",
      TRUE                                    ~ "NS"
    )
  )

# Label top genes by |lfc|
labs <- volc_df |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(abs(lfc))) |>
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 20) |>
  dplyr::pull(gene)

# 4) Plot
p_volc <- ggplot(volc_df, aes(x = lfc, y = neglog10)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = status), size = 1.6, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Up = "#d62728", Down = "#1f77b4", NS = "grey70")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(padj_cut), linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_cut, lfc_cut), linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.3) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = subset(volc_df, gene %in% labs),
    aes(label = gene),
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.35,
    point.padding = 0.2,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    seed = 123
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "ECM genes: rGBM vs Control",
    subtitle = "limma on batch-adjusted log2(FPKM+1) | Contrast = rGBM − Control",
    x = expression(log[2]~fold~change),
    y = expression(-log[10]~adjusted~p~value)
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank())

print(p_volc)

# 5) Save outputs
outdir <- "/Data/Outputs/ECM_DEG"
if (!dir.exists(outdir)) dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE)

ggsave(file.path(outdir, "Volcano_ECM_rGBM_vs_Control.pdf"),
       p_volc, width = 6.8, height = 5.6, units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)

readr::write_csv(volc_df, file.path(outdir, "Volcano_ECM_rGBM_vs_Control_plotdata.csv"))
readr::write_csv(res,     file.path(outdir, "DE_full_ECM_rGBM_vs_Control.csv"))

# Quick counts for the log
print(table(volc_df$status))

```

```{r}
# 1) Genes + tumor subset
genes_target <- toupper(c("COL1A1", "COL3A1"))

Y <- Y_all[genes_found, , drop = FALSE]

# 2) Limma design (rGBM - GBM)
sm_tumor$group <- factor(sm_tumor$group, levels = c("GBM", "rGBM"))
design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group, data = sm_tumor)
colnames(design) <- levels(sm_tumor$group)
contrast <- makeContrasts(rGBM_vs_GBM = rGBM - GBM, levels = design)

fit  <- lmFit(Y, design)
fit2 <- eBayes(contrasts.fit(fit, contrast))
res  <- topTable(fit2, coef = "rGBM_vs_GBM", number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")

res_out <- res %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%

  dplyr::left_join(sm_tumor %>% dplyr::select(sample_id, group), by = "sample_id") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(

  geom_boxplot(width = 0.65, outlier.size = 0.6, alpha = 0.9, color = "grey20") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, alpha = 0.5, size = 1.6, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_cols) +
  facet_wrap(~ Gene, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "COL1A1 and COL3A1 expression (log2(FPKM+1))",

  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +

        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
```

#### Metalloproteinase 

```{r}
# 1) Genes + tumor subset
genes_target <- toupper(c("MMP2", "MMP9"))

tumor_keep <- sample_meta_all$group %in% c("GBM", "rGBM")
sm_tumor   <- droplevels(sample_meta_all[tumor_keep, ])
Y_all      <- expr_adj_ecm[, tumor_keep, drop = FALSE]

rownames(Y_all) <- toupper(rownames(Y_all))
genes_found <- intersect(genes_target, rownames(Y_all))
if (length(genes_found) == 0) stop("Requested genes not found in expr_adj_ecm.")
if (length(setdiff(genes_target, genes_found)) > 0)
  warning("Missing genes: ", paste(setdiff(genes_target, genes_found), collapse = ", "))

Y <- Y_all[genes_found, , drop = FALSE]

# 2) Limma design (rGBM - GBM)
sm_tumor$group <- factor(sm_tumor$group, levels = c("GBM", "rGBM"))
design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + group, data = sm_tumor)
colnames(design) <- levels(sm_tumor$group)
contrast <- makeContrasts(rGBM_vs_GBM = rGBM - GBM, levels = design)

fit  <- lmFit(Y, design)
fit2 <- eBayes(contrasts.fit(fit, contrast))
res  <- topTable(fit2, coef = "rGBM_vs_GBM", number = Inf, adjust.method = "BH")

res_out <- res %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  dplyr::transmute(gene, logFC, AveExpr, t, P.Value, adj.P.Val, B) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(adj.P.Val)

write_csv(res_out, "/Data/Outputs/TwoGene_DEG_rGBM_vs_GBM_MMP2_MMP9.csv")

# 3) Long table + plot
df_long <- Y %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-Gene, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "log2_expr") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(sm_tumor %>% dplyr::select(sample_id, group), by = "sample_id") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Gene  = factor(Gene, levels = genes_found),
    group = factor(group, levels = c("GBM", "rGBM"))
  )

group_cols <- c(GBM = "#1f77b4", rGBM = "#d62728")

p_two_gene <- ggplot(df_long, aes(x = group, y = log2_expr, fill = group)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.65, outlier.size = 0.6, alpha = 0.9, color = "grey20") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, alpha = 0.5, size = 1.6, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_cols) +
  facet_wrap(~ Gene, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "MMP2 and MMP9 expression (log2(FPKM+1))",
    subtitle = "Batch-adjusted (tumor-only correction); rGBM vs GBM",
    x = NULL, y = "log2 expression"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"))

caption_txt <- paste(
  paste0(res_out$gene, ": logFC(rGBM-GBM)=", round(res_out$logFC, 3),
         ", adj.P.Val=", signif(res_out$adj.P.Val, 3)),
  collapse = "   |   "
)
p_two_gene <- p_two_gene + labs(caption = caption_txt)

print(p_two_gene)
ggsave("/Data/Outputs/TwoGene_MMP2_MMP9_rGBM_vs_GBM.pdf",
       plot = p_two_gene, width = 7.5, height = 4.0, units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)

# 4) Quick group means table

  dplyr::group_by(Gene, group) %>%
```

### Outcome Analysis

Stratify the data between above and below 12 months survival.

```{r}
# --- rGBM-only: COL1A1/COL3A1 vs 12-month survival with dots & adj p-values ---

stopifnot(exists("expr_adj_all"), exists("sample_meta_all"))

# 1) rGBM-only metadata with survival
cutoff_days <- 365.25
meta_rgbm <- sample_meta_all %>%
  dplyr::filter(group == "rGBM") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    surv12 = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(OS_days) ~ NA_character_,
      OS_days <= cutoff_days ~ "≤12 months",
      OS_days >  cutoff_days ~ ">12 months"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(surv12))

# 2) Expression for target genes
genes <- c("COL1A1", "COL3A1")
genes <- intersect(genes, rownames(expr_adj_all))
stopifnot(length(genes) > 0)

df_expr <- expr_adj_all[genes, meta_rgbm$sample_id, drop = FALSE] %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-Gene, names_to = "sample_id", values_to = "log2_expr") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(meta_rgbm %>% dplyr::select(sample_id, surv12), by = "sample_id")

# 3) Stats: mean diff, t-test, wilcox, adjusted p-values
stats_tbl <- df_expr %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Gene) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_le_12   = sum(surv12 == "≤12 months"),
    n_gt_12   = sum(surv12 == ">12 months"),
    mean_le   = mean(log2_expr[surv12 == "≤12 months"], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_gt   = mean(log2_expr[surv12 == ">12 months"], na.rm = TRUE),
    diff_mean = mean_gt - mean_le,
    t_p       = tryCatch(t.test(log2_expr ~ surv12)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_),
    wilcox_p  = tryCatch(wilcox.test(log2_expr ~ surv12, exact = FALSE)$p.value, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_adj_t      = p.adjust(t_p, method = "BH"),
    p_adj_wilcox = p.adjust(wilcox_p, method = "BH")
  )

print(stats_tbl)

outdir <- "/Data/Outputs/ECM_Survival"
if (!dir.exists(outdir)) dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE)
readr::write_csv(stats_tbl, file.path(outdir, "rGBM_COL1A1_COL3A1_by_12moSurvival_stats_withAdj.csv"))

# 4) Plot: boxplots + jittered dots
p <- ggplot(df_expr, aes(x = surv12, y = log2_expr, fill = surv12)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = surv12), width = 0.15, alpha = 0.6, size = 1.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ Gene, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("≤12 months" = "#1f77b4", ">12 months" = "#d62728")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("≤12 months" = "#1f77b4", ">12 months" = "#d62728")) +
  labs(
    title = "rGBM only: COL1A1 / COL3A1 expression by 12-month survival",
    subtitle = "log₂(FPKM+1) expression, with t-test FDR-adjusted p-values shown below",
    x = "Overall Survival Category (rGBM)",
    y = expression(log[2]~expression~(FPKM+1))
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

print(p)

# 5) Save
ggsave(file.path(outdir, "rGBM_COL1A1_COL3A1_by_12moSurvival_withDots.pdf"),
       p, width = 7, height = 5, device = cairo_pdf)

```

```{r}

# --- Data (use df_ecm if present, else load full CSV) ---
data_to_plot <- if (exists("df_ecm")) {
  df_ecm
} else {
  read_csv("/Data/Inputs/WT_DE_analysis.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    rename(
      estimate = Estimate,
      pval     = `Pr(>|t|)`,
      gene     = Gene,
      group1   = Group1,
      group2   = Group2,
      fdr      = FDR
    )
}

# --- Parameters ---
outdir  <- "/Data/Outputs/GeoMx"; if (!dir.exists(outdir)) dir.create(outdir, TRUE)
fdr_cut <- 0.05
lfc_cut <- 0.25         # set to 0 if you only want FDR thresholding
n_label <- 15           # top-N labels by FDR

# --- Prep ---
dfp <- data_to_plot |>
  mutate(
    fdr = as.numeric(fdr),
    estimate = as.numeric(estimate),
    fdr_clamped = pmax(fdr, 1e-300),             # avoid Inf from log10(0)
    neglog10_fdr = -log10(fdr_clamped),
    status = case_when(
      fdr < fdr_cut & estimate >=  lfc_cut ~ "Up",
      fdr < fdr_cut & estimate <= -lfc_cut ~ "Down",
      TRUE ~ "NS"
    )
  )

# label the top-N smallest FDR genes
labs_to_label <- dfp |> arrange(fdr) |> slice_head(n = n_label) |> pull(gene)

# comparison tag for filenames
g1 <- unique(dfp$group1)[1] %||% "Group1"
g2 <- unique(dfp$group2)[1] %||% "Group2"
cmp_tag <- paste0(g1, "_vs_", g2)

# --- Volcano (x = Estimate; y = -log10(FDR)) ---
p_volc <- ggplot(dfp, aes(x = estimate, y = neglog10_fdr)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = status), size = 1.6, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Up = "#d62728", Down = "#1f77b4", NS = "grey70")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(fdr_cut), linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_cut, lfc_cut), linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = dfp |> filter(gene %in% labs_to_label),
    aes(label = gene),
    max.overlaps = Inf, box.padding = 0.35, point.padding = 0.2,
    min.segment.length = 0, seed = 123, size = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(cmp_tag, " — Volcano (y = −log10 FDR)"),
    x = expression(log[2]~fold~change~(Estimate)),
    y = expression(-log[10]~FDR),
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

# --- Save ---
ggsave(file.path(outdir, paste0("volcano_PADJ_vs_Estimate_", cmp_tag, ".pdf")),
       p_volc, width = 7, height = 5)


# Quick counts (optional)
dfp |> summarise(
  n_total = n(),
  n_sig   = sum(fdr < fdr_cut, na.rm = TRUE),
  n_up    = sum(fdr < fdr_cut & estimate > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
  n_down  = sum(fdr < fdr_cut & estimate < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
) |> print()
```

```{r}
  df_ecm
} else {
```
```{r}
  read_csv("/Data/Inputs/WT_DE_analysis.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>

outdir  <- "/Data/Outputs/GeoMx"; if (!dir.exists(outdir)) dir.create(outdir, TRUE)
```

```{r}
g2 <- unique(data_use$group2)[1] %||% "Group2"

# --- Split significant sets (FDR only) ---

  mutate(
    direction = case_when(
      estimate > 0 ~ paste0("Higher in ", g1),
      estimate < 0 ~ paste0("Higher in ", g2),
      TRUE ~ "No change"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(fdr), fdr < fdr_cut)

sig_up_in_g2 <- sig_all %>% filter(estimate < 0) %>% arrange(fdr)

# --- Save full tables ---

          file.path(outdir, paste0("sig_up_in_", g1, "_FDRlt", fdr_cut, "_", cmp_tag, ".csv")))
write_csv(sig_up_in_g2,
          file.path(outdir, paste0("sig_up_in_", g2, "_FDRlt", fdr_cut, "_", cmp_tag, ".csv")))

# --- Print tidy preview tables (top 25 each) ---

  dplyr::select(gene, estimate, pval, fdr, direction) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 25)

}

cat("\n== Significant (FDR < 0.05) — Up in ", g2, " ==\n", sep = "")
if ("knitr" %in% rownames(installed.packages())) {

} else {

}


# --- Quick counts ---

  sig_up_in_g1   = nrow(sig_up_in_g1),
  sig_up_in_g2   = nrow(sig_up_in_g2)
)
print(summary_counts)
```

```{r}
labs_to_label <- dfp |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(abs_estimate)) |>
  dplyr::slice_head(n = n_label_abs) |>
  dplyr::pull(gene)

# Comparison tag for filenames
g1 <- unique(dfp$group1)[1]; if (is.null(g1) || is.na(g1)) g1 <- "Group1"
g2 <- unique(dfp$group2)[1]; if (is.null(g2) || is.na(g2)) g2 <- "Group2"
cmp_tag <- paste0(g1, "_vs_", g2)

# --- Volcano (x = Estimate; y = -log10(FDR)) with |Estimate| labels ---
p_volc <- ggplot(dfp, aes(x = estimate, y = neglog10_fdr)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = status), size = 1.6, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Up = "#d62728", Down = "#1f77b4", NS = "grey70")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(fdr_cut), linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_cut, lfc_cut), linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.3) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = dfp |> dplyr::filter(gene %in% labs_to_label),
    aes(label = gene),
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.35,
    point.padding = 0.2,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    seed = 123,
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(cmp_tag, " — Volcano (labels: top ", n_label_abs, " by |log2FC|)"),
    x = expression(log[2]~fold~change~(Estimate)),
    y = expression(-log[10]~FDR),
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

# --- Save PDF only ---
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(outdir, paste0("volcano_labelTopAbsLFC_", n_label_abs, "_", cmp_tag, ".pdf")),
  plot = p_volc, width = 7, height = 5
)

```

#### Flipped for rec vs pri
```{r}

# If you already have data_use, keep it; else load:
if (!exists("data_use")) {
  data_use <- readr::read_csv("/Data/Inputs/WT_DE_analysis.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      estimate = Estimate, pval = `Pr(>|t|)`, gene = Gene,
      group1 = Group1, group2 = Group2, fdr = FDR
    )
}

outdir <- "/Data/Outputs/GeoMx"; if (!dir.exists(outdir)) dir.create(outdir, TRUE)

# SAFE flip: Rec − Pri (negate estimate, swap groups via temp)
data_flip <- data_use %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    estimate = -as.numeric(estimate),
    .g1 = group1, .g2 = group2
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(group1 = .g2, group2 = .g1) %>%
  dplyr::select(-.g1, -.g2)

# Quick sanity check: should *not* be the same
# print(dplyr::count(data_flip, group1, group2))

# Save flipped CSV
g1_new <- unique(data_flip$group1)[1] %||% "Group1"
g2_new <- unique(data_flip$group2)[1] %||% "Group2"
cmp_tag <- paste0(g1_new, "_vs_", g2_new)
flipped_csv <- file.path(outdir, paste0("WT_DE_analysis_FLIPPED_", cmp_tag, ".csv"))
readr::write_csv(data_flip, flipped_csv)

# Volcano with top 20 by |log2FC| (PDF only)
fdr_cut <- 0.05; lfc_cut <- 0.25; n_label_abs <- 20
dfp <- data_flip %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    fdr = as.numeric(fdr),
    fdr_clamped = pmax(fdr, 1e-300),
    neglog10_fdr = -log10(fdr_clamped),
    abs_estimate = abs(estimate),
    status = dplyr::case_when(
      fdr < fdr_cut & estimate >=  lfc_cut ~ "Up",
      fdr < fdr_cut & estimate <= -lfc_cut ~ "Down",
      TRUE ~ "NS"
    )
  )
labs_to_label <- dfp %>% dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(abs_estimate)) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = n_label_abs) %>% dplyr::pull(gene)

p_volc <- ggplot(dfp, aes(x = estimate, y = neglog10_fdr)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = status), size = 1.6, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Up = "#d62728", Down = "#1f77b4", NS = "grey70")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(fdr_cut), linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-lfc_cut, lfc_cut), linetype = 2, linewidth = 0.3) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = dplyr::filter(dfp, gene %in% labs_to_label),
    aes(label = gene), max.overlaps = Inf, box.padding = 0.35,
    point.padding = 0.2, min.segment.length = 0, seed = 123, size = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0(cmp_tag, " — Volcano (labels: top ", n_label_abs, " by |log2FC|)"),
    x = expression(log[2]~fold~change~(Estimate)),
    y = expression(-log[10]~FDR),
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

pdf_path <- file.path(outdir, paste0("volcano_FLIPPED_labelTopAbsLFC_", n_label_abs, "_", cmp_tag, ".pdf"))
ggsave(pdf_path, p_volc, width = 7, height = 5)

cat("Fixed labels ✅\nFlipped CSV: ", flipped_csv, "\nVolcano PDF: ", pdf_path, "\n", sep = "")

```
